title: Unbounded Violations of the Square-Root Degree Bound
summary: We disprove the Gopalan–Servedio square-root conjecture, even up to an arbitrary constant factor. For every real C > 0, there is a nonconstant Boolean function $`f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}`$ on a finite sign cube such that $`\displaystyle \sum_{i=1}^n \widehat f(\{i\})\gt C\sqrt{\deg(f)}.`$ Here $`\widehat f(\{i\})`$ is the linear Fourier coefficient associated with the i th input, and $`\deg(f)`$ is the degree of the real multilinear polynomial representing f .
family_title: Boolean functions violate the square-root degree bound by arbitrary factors

review.reason: Disproves the Gopalan-Servedio square-root conjecture on Boolean function degree bounds.
